races.paceDynamic: Signora is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the gates, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure in this 15-runner maiden. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics (Ridersinthesky, Expert Dancer, Billy Jean, Green Interlude, Lamberella), the pace will be modest early before quickening from the 3f marker. Prominent runners like Rayzera and White Lily will track the leader but lack the natural speed to challenge Signora's position. This shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Signora controls throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Signora maintains her natural front-running position without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: She dictates ideal fractions and has first run on the field, while the mass of hold-up horses get caught in traffic. Her recent Dundalk seconds show she's in form and this tactical advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent challenge succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Rayzera or White Lily can get into an ideal tracking position behind Signora
scenarios.body: The tracker gets a perfect trip while Signora weakens after setting the pace alone, with hold-up horses still caught behind the leading pair. Rayzera's stamina improvement and White Lily's course form become crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse finds gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one hold-up runner finds clear daylight in the straight
scenarios.body: Ridersinthesky or Expert Dancer gets a dream run through while others remain trapped, their superior class telling late. The maiden form book suggests these fillies have more ability than the front division.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Weak pace favours all
scenarios.trigger: If Signora goes too slowly and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: Multiple runners get their chance but none have enough pace to separate, creating a messy finish where any of six could prevail. Divine Legend and Billy Jean could emerge from the pack if the tempo collapses.

watchPoints.text: Signora's early position is crucial - if she doesn't lead cleanly from the gates, the entire pace scenario collapses
Traffic problems inevitable with 10+ hold-up runners - watch for Ridersinthesky and Expert Dancer finding racing room
Rayzera's positioning behind Signora will determine if she can mount a serious challenge or gets caught behind the leader
White Lily's 195-day absence could see fitness tell late despite her tactical advantage
Any hold-up horse getting an early position will have a significant advantage over those held up in rear

races.paceDynamic: Spacebound will control this race as the lone confirmed front runner, setting his own tempo without early pressure from the 18-runner field. Queen Lioness, El Rehaiby, Treasure Rose and Coul Dreamer should settle in prominent positions behind him, while the bulk of the field adopts hold-up tactics with runners like Senna's Girl, Je Suis Celebre, Tyraxes and Sron Na Caise looking to come from behind. With Spacebound able to dictate fractions and so many hold-up horses potentially getting into trouble in running, this race shape strongly favours horses who can race prominently or on the pace rather than those requiring luck in running from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Spacebound Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Spacebound gets an uncontested lead and maintains sustainable fractions throughout.
scenarios.body: He can kick clear in the straight before the hold-up brigade gets organized, with prominent racers like Treasure Rose and El Rehaiby best placed to give chase. The sheer number of hold-up horses creates traffic problems that benefit those racing closer to the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely run and Spacebound weakens in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Treasure Rose, El Rehaiby or Queen Lioness can capitalize on their forward positions to strike, avoiding the inevitable traffic problems that will affect the many hold-up horses. Their prominent racing styles prove ideal when the early leader falters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and clear runs emerge for the back markers.
scenarios.body: Senna's Girl or Tyraxes could find the necessary racing room to unleash their finishing kicks, but this requires the race to fall apart up front and traffic problems to be minimal. Even then, they face the challenge of making up significant ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Enchanted Lady shows immediate ability on debut or Ballysax Stew transfers his hurdles form to the flat.
scenarios.body: A newcomer with breeding to match could exploit the tactical nature of this race, though both face questions over readiness and race fitness. The large field provides cover for an unexposed runner to spring a surprise.

watchPoints.text: Spacebound could get too easy a time in front if no pressure materializes from the prominent runners

Market support for newcomer Enchanted Lady would suggest immediate ability from the breeding
Treasure Rose has been knocking on the door in maidens and suits the likely race shape
Senna's Girl has the class edge but faces a tactical nightmare from her preferred hold-up style

races.paceDynamic: Electric Night appears the most likely pace-setter with several prominent runners including Glamazon, Teffian Warrior, Nicky Larson, and Linger For Longer likely to track close behind. This creates a reasonable gallop but not extreme pressure, with the large field of 15 runners meaning those who get cover in midfield positions should have every chance. The combination of soft ground, 1m trip, and multiple hold-up horses suggests the pace will be testing enough to set up a finish where horses coming from off the pace will have a clear advantage over those forced to race prominently early.

scenarios.label: A

races.paceDynamic: Expound and Walhaan are the confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, ensuring a genuine gallop from the start. With 19 runners and multiple prominent types like Collecting Coin, Fast Tara, and Great Mover tracking close, the pace will be honest throughout with no let-up. The large field and dual pace angles will create a searching test that builds steadily. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can finish fast, as the early pace battle and sustained gallop will set up perfectly for closers to sweep past tiring leaders.

scenarios.body: Expound or Walhaan could get away with controlled fractions and have enough left to hold off late challengers. The big field might not organize a sustained chase quickly enough.

This dual pace pressure should create an honest gallop through the middle sections, preventing the race from becoming a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and hold-up horses who can capitalize on the pace battle, with pure front-runners vulnerable to being softened up.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Crinshawn is the only confirmed front-runner with prominent tendencies, likely to set a sustainable pace without early pressure in this 19-runner handicap. Hosanna Power may provide some early company from her prominent style, but the majority of the field are hold-up horses who will settle behind the leaders. The pace will be honest but not frantic over 1m4f, with the large field creating natural gaps and positioning battles turning into the straight. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can find clear runs and finish late, as they'll have both pace to aim at and room to maneuver in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Crinshawn sets honest fractions without being hassled early
scenarios.body: The large field of hold-up horses will have perfect conditions to unleash late runs with clear pace to aim at. Strong stayers like Khormor Syd and Church Mountain can time their challenges perfectly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Crinshawn gets an uncontested lead with slow early fractions
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will have energy reserves for the finish while closers struggle without enough pace to run at. Miss Crinshawn and Hosanna Power can exploit their forward positions in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Creates Opportunity
scenarios.trigger: If Hosanna Power and Miss Crinshawn engage in early speed battle
scenarios.body: The two pace angles will compromise each other, setting up perfect conditions for mid-division runners to sweep past. Hold-up horses with tactical pace like Deed Pole can benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Suits Handy Types
scenarios.trigger: If field bunches up turning for home with tactical pace throughout
scenarios.body: Horses positioned prominently but not committed early will have the best of both worlds in a cavalry charge finish. Those with some early pace who haven't used it all will be perfectly placed.

watchPoints.text: Miss Crinshawn is the sole pace angle in a field of 18 hold-up horses, creating massive tactical advantage if she gets easy lead
Several runners including Patrick Street, Kilgharrahs Love and Almenfee show concerning patterns of fading in the finish over similar trips
Multiple horses returning from long breaks including Deed Pole (400 days) and Rapid Sequence (242 days) could need the run
Large field of 19 runners may create traffic problems for hold-up horses despite pace advantage
